pages.text: A hive takes up your chestplate slot, so it can carry the chestplate for you.$(br2)Put a hive and any chestplate into a crafting grid: the hive now has that chestplate's armour, toughness and enchantments, and looks like it on you.
Put an armoured hive into a crafting grid on its own to take the chestplate back out.$(br2)If the built-in chestplate breaks, only the chestplate is lost. The hive and its bees stay.
